worn_dirk.name: Worn Dirk
worn_dirk.desc: A nicked blade that has seen kinder years. Still sharp enough.

ashblade.name: Ashblade
ashblade.desc: Forged in hearth-cinder. The edge holds a faint ember glow.

thornbow.name: Thornbow
thornbow.desc: Bent moonwood strung with wolf-gut. Prefers distance.

cinder_rod.name: Cinder Rod
cinder_rod.desc: A charred staff capped with a smoldering geode.

hide_vest.name: Hide Vest
hide_vest.desc: Gloom-wolf hide, boiled and laced. Quiet when you walk.

ironband_mail.name: Ironband Mail
ironband_mail.desc: Overlapping iron rings darkened with pitch.

dusk_cloak.name: Dusk Cloak
dusk_cloak.desc: A moth-eaten mantle that drinks torchlight.

ember_charm.name: Ember Charm
ember_charm.desc: A coal that never cools, hung on braided gut.

moss_charm.name: Moss Charm
moss_charm.desc: River-moss bound around a river stone. Steadies the breath.

hearth_charm.name: Hearth Charm
hearth_charm.desc: A splinter of the Hollow's first fire.

emberwood.name: Emberwood
emberwood.desc: Warm to the touch even when dead. Smells of resin and dusk.

moonbloom.name: Moonbloom
moonbloom.desc: Pale petals that open only in the Hollow's long dusk.

imp_cinder.name: Imp Cinder
imp_cinder.desc: A thumb of slag that sparks if squeezed.

iron_shard.name: Iron Shard
iron_shard.desc: A flake of the old veins under Emberfen.

hearthbread.name: Hearthbread
hearthbread.desc: Dense, spiced, still a little warm. Restores 28 health.

moontea.name: Moontea
moontea.desc: Bitter silver brew. Restores 18 health and steadies the hand.

cinder_salve.name: Cinder Salve
cinder_salve.desc: A tin of glowing paste. Restores 52 health.

ember_coin.name: Ember Coin
ember_coin.desc: Copper discs stamped with a closed eye. The Hollow's only coin.

tutor_note.name: Maera's Note
tutor_note.desc: Walk. Gather. Hunt. Trade. The Hollow remembers those who share.

stag_antler.name: Hollow Antler
stag_antler.desc: A rare tine from the Hollow Stag. The forest leans toward you.

cool_down.name: The Cool Down
cool_down.desc: Signature vanilla-mint shake from The Shake Bar, 2545 E Hwy 50. Best-seller.

creamy_dream.name: Creamy Dream
creamy_dream.desc: Oreo milkshake from The Shake Bar. Cookies all the way down.

biscoff_max.name: Biscoff Max
biscoff_max.desc: Cookie-butter shake from The Shake Bar.

coco_loco.name: CoCo-Loco
coco_loco.desc: Coconut-chocolate shake. Slightly unhinged, in a helpful way.

diner_vanilla.name: Diner Vanilla
diner_vanilla.desc: Steak n Shake vanilla. Same lot as The Shake Bar.

diner_chocolate.name: Diner Chocolate
diner_chocolate.desc: Steak n Shake chocolate diner shake.

black_white_shake.name: Black & White
black_white_shake.desc: Steak n Shake black-and-white diner shake.

birthday_cake_scoop.name: Birthday Cake Scoop
birthday_cake_scoop.desc: Bruster's Building H. Sprinkles for morale.

bacon_milkshake.name: Bacon Milkshake
bacon_milkshake.desc: Five Guys custom shake, 1600 N Hancock Rd. A dare in a cup.

peanut_butter_shake.name: Peanut Butter Shake
peanut_butter_shake.desc: Five Guys. The hug, not the dare.

moment_31.name: 31 Moment
moment_31.desc: Mystery scoop. Tess will not name the flavor.

butterscotch_concrete.name: Butterscotch Concrete
butterscotch_concrete.desc: Culver's, 1431 Johns Lake Rd. Eat it upside down.

oreo_blizzard.name: Oreo Blizzard
oreo_blizzard.desc: Dairy Queen, 860 US Hwy 27 (34714). They will flip it.

reeses_blizzard.name: Reese's Blizzard
reeses_blizzard.desc: DQ Blizzard. Peanut butter cups in a snowstorm.

m_chocolate_shake.name: Window Chocolate Shake
m_chocolate_shake.desc: McDonald's Clermont. Machine is, for once, on.

chocolate_frosty.name: Chocolate Frosty
chocolate_frosty.desc: Wendy's Clermont. Spoon or straw, we do not take sides.

vanilla_frosty.name: Vanilla Frosty
vanilla_frosty.desc: Wendy's vanilla Frosty. A little speed in the slush.

moon_berry.name: Moon Berry
moon_berry.desc: Wilds berry that only looks silver at dusk.
